_comment: Per-location voice exemptions. Each key is a locator, each value is the reason. VOICE.md §6 allows only three exceptions: direct quotes from an official description, legal copy, and code/config/technical reference. Keep this list short — every entry is a claim the site is making about its own standards.
deals.jsonl:jetbrains-junie.desc: technical reference — "IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate" is a JetBrains product tier name, not marketing copy
template:voice.html: direct quote — the page lists the banned words as a reference, not as marketing copy
